title: Measuring Human-AI Alignment as an Early Indicator for Effective Collaboration in Hybrid SE Teams
abstract: arXiv:2611.21633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As AI agents increasingly integrate into software engineering (SE) processes, ensuring effective collaboration in these hybrid teams becomes a critical challenge. While existing metrics focus on observing dynamic run-time performance, there is a lack of systematic, static measurements for early human-AI alignment -- the degree to which an AI's actions and granularity map to human expectations. This position paper proposes a research agenda to develop an SE-specific alignment metric suite drawing principles from software architecture, organizational psychology, and human-computer interaction. Furthermore, it outlines a validation methodology using concepts and techniques from business process monitoring (BPM) and introduces static assessment tools leveraging declarative BPM languages to ensure agents adhere to specific project constraints.

translated_title: 将人机对齐作为混合软件工程团队有效协作的早期指标进行测量
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体日益融入软件工程（SE）流程，确保这些混合团队的有效协作成为一项关键挑战。现有指标侧重于观察动态运行时性能，但缺乏针对早期人机对齐——即AI的行为和粒度与人类期望匹配的程度——的系统性静态测量。本立场论文提出了一个研究议程，旨在借鉴软件架构、组织心理学和人机交互的原理，开发一套SE特定的对齐指标体系。此外，本文概述了一种利用业务流程监控（BPM）概念和技术的验证方法，并引入了利用声明式BPM语言的静态评估工具，以确保智能体遵守特定的项目约束。
tldr: 本文提出开发一套软件工程专用的人机对齐静态测量指标体系，借鉴软件架构、组织心理学和人机交互原理，并利用声明式业务流程监控语言构建静态评估工具，作为评估混合人机团队有效协作的早期指标。
